name: Codex
description: Tier A capture: subscribes to the OpenAI Codex CLI native hook API and records every tool invocation to RedLog's timeline.
author: your-handle

capture.name: Codex (native hook)
capture.description: Records Codex CLI tool calls (command, output preview, session id, cwd) via Codex's native hook API.

manualSteps.label: Open (or create) Codex's config file so we can register the hook

Add a [hooks] block pointing at the RedLog hook script. Adjust the event name to match Codex's current hook API (e.g. 'post_tool_use', 'tool_result', or the exact name from https://developers.openai.com/codex/hooks/).
Restart the Codex CLI so it picks up the new hook config
Verify: run a Codex tool call, then check RedLog Settings ▸ Events for a 'codex_tool' entry

NOTE — the exact [hooks] key names in the snippet above are a best-guess against the shape documented at https://developers.openai.com/codex/hooks/. Confirm against the current Codex docs before relying on this in a real engagement.
